boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 92 packs colored blocks (a green L-shape, an orange `7` counter block, a large red square, blue, yellow, and purple pieces with lock/key icons) into the upper section while two massive chambers fill the lower board — counter `15` in a red frame on top, counter `10` in an orange frame below. Clear the upper section to open lanes, feed the `15` chamber first, sort the spill, then feed the `10` chamber.
landmarks: Block Out Level 92 packs colored blocks (a green L-shape, an orange `7` counter block, a large red square, blue, yellow, and purple pieces with lock/key icons) into the upper section while two massive chambers fill the lower board — counter `15` in a red frame on top, counter `10` in an orange frame below.
Clear the upper section to open lanes, feed the `15` chamber first, sort the spill, then feed the `10` chamber.
The board mixes Green, Orange, Yellow and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Clear the upper section as fast as possible — the two chamber feeds need all the remaining time.
Remove the small cyan and green blocks in the border strip before starting the `15` chamber feed.
Sort the spilled blocks immediately after the `15` chamber collapses, before they jam the `10` chamber lane.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Slide the green L-shaped block in the top-left through the left-wall exit to open the first lane (02:54 in the video).

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Begin feeding the orange `7` block upward through the top exit — seven passes (02:49–02:39).

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Clear the lock/key pairs: remove the key blocks to unlock the blue pieces beside the large red square (02:44).

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Push the yellow block right through the right-wall exit, then extract the large red square block from the center (02:39).

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Clear the small cyan and green blocks in the border strip between upper and lower zones before they drift into the feed lane (02:34).

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Begin feeding the upper chamber (counter `15`) through its exit lane — keep this lane permanently clear for fifteen passes (02:29–02:15).

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: After the `15` chamber collapses, immediately sort the spilled red, blue, green, and yellow blocks before they block the lower lane (02:10).

steps.title: Move 8
steps.instruction: Feed the lower chamber (counter `10`) through the bottom exits — ten passes to finish (02:10–02:00).

failurePoints: Starting the `15` chamber feed while the border strip still has small cyan and green blocks — they drift into the feed lane and stall the counter mid-pass.
Ignoring the spilled blocks after the `15` chamber collapses — they jam the `10` chamber's exit lane and force multiple recovery moves.
